all_cases.scope: Actual selectable4/8/16/32:1 transistor tree. Every actual HBT/MOS is bound and screened. Native clock common-mode references each drive at most three actual selector pairs. Differential clock phases remain external ideal sources; output_bias=native_res replaces final/TX reference currents with native resistor feeds. pre_bias=native_res replaces all prestage ideal currents; clock_bias=native_res also replaces the clock-reference ideal current with a real loaded resistor feed. Each input is8Gb/s divided by stream count; final8GT/s256-bit original oracle unchanged. Clock modulation is still externally imposed. No PLL/CDR, physical tree layout/PEX, ESD, jitter/BER or fullPHY acceptance.

signals.method: All original source bits at unchanged 0.3/0.5/0.7 UI; 100mV limit. No fitted latency, resampling phase adjustment, or actual-input-derived oracle.
